formula: On fit weak steps where uncalibrated Q/Cost picks stop or abstain and a specialist is legal, excess = best terminal Q/Cost - best legal specialist Q/Cost. tau = median(excess) + 3 * MAD(excess). MAD is the median absolute deviation from the median. The multiplier 3 is the usual robust fence and was not scored on the official hold-out or on rgb_test. At decision time, if a terminal action wins by less than tau, the rule utility selects. Otherwise the action stays argmax Q/Cost. Learned Q weights are unchanged.
population: rgb_train fit weak steps whose uncalibrated Q/Cost action is stop or abstain and a specialist is legal. The official hold-out is not an input.
not_p0d: Q/Cost decision calibration on logged rgb_train weak steps. Not the same-budget full-set energy table. No reinforcement learning. rgb_test labels were not read.
